'''Thosa''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of barren rock [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] [[Dostra Major]] in the [[Dostra system]]. It was the fifth planet in the [[Star system/Legends|system]], and was orbited by two [[Moon/Legends|moons]].<ref name="AIR" />
